entries: Each time {first} neared {PRIZE:!inner}, {VICE} tripped everything up.
At {landmark}, {first} bumped into {SOMEONE:!threatening}, who offered terrible advice {MANNER}.
{first} told one more fib to {CLOSE:human}, and {landmark} filled with gossip.
{first} tried to {DO_THING} {THING} and ended up in the {rival}'s office.
